name: Add a diagram feedback path
intent: Add exactly one blue return arrow below the row from Check back to Create, labeled Revise, without changing the existing diagram.

criteria.requirement: Exactly one muted-blue return path starts at the bottom of Check, goes below the row, and ends with an arrowhead entering the bottom of Create. Its direction is Check to Create.
The new path is labeled exactly Revise once, clearly readable below the main row.
Exactly four original cards remain ordered Brief, Create, Check, Deliver, with the three existing arrows pointing left to right. No added node.
Preserve the title From idea to image, card positions, labels, icons, blue Create fill, and ivory background visually.
No connector or label crosses existing card text or title; no extra words besides Revise.
